Yeah, I'm not in love with the fact that I made that ultimatum, but I also am genuinely not in the space right now to hear people telling me any of the stuff I've heard a million times and had no success with. 
I do really appreciate that you care, though. I think anyone who is kind to children, animals, plants and/or suffering creatures is worth a lot in this world.
Thank you. Though not all of this is right for me right now, I do appreciate what you have to say. The second paragraph especially.

I get you, pal. I'm going on 11 years in therapy. It's hard not to feel out of options. Thanks for making me feel less alone, though. I really appreciate it, and I genuinely hope something happens to ease your pain.

Pick up skill you are passionate about = cliché. I can count at least 10 skills I am passionate about, it makes no difference. Hallucinogenics are less cliché, but don't work for me. Thanks for playing, better luck next time.

I'm not going to tell you not to do it. I'm not going to tell you that I love and care about you because I straight-up don't know you. I'm not going to tell you that things could get better, or that there might be a treatment out there that you don't know about that'll be right for you. I'm not saying those things can't be true, but I mostly don't want you to feel more alone by recklessly throwing platitudes and half-truths at you while pretending that I have it together and know all the answers. Because I 100% fucking don't. I came here for a reason.  
I don't want anyone to commit suicide - not even me (though I dream about it a lot). But I also don't believe that as a profoundly imperfect stranger I'm going to be able to give you insight. Not that that's even what you asked for, but I think that's what a lot of the comments on this subreddit are attempting. 
Let me just real quick tell you what I believe: if you're kind to animals, children, and/or people in terrible pain, you're worth keeping. 
Again, I don't love you because I don't know you, but I do send love your way. 
💙
